messages:
Ibrahim: quick sync — planning the next catalog cohort: this one targets quantized & int8-first variants. need clear gates for onboard. timeline: end of week. who picks up what?
Dina: I can own the evaluation matrix. propose: accuracy delta <= 1.5% on our core NLU set, embedding MRR loss < 0.02 on 5k QA pairs, p95 latency <= 420ms at 16 concurrent streams, throughput >= 3x baseline on batching config. cost/unit must be >=10% savings vs float baseline.
Marcus: +1. add stability checks: KV cache correctness probe, memory leak smoke for 6h, and a deterministic sample regen test. also define rollout rollback triggers.
Pat (SRE): rollback triggers: error rate > 1.5% sustained 5m, latency p95 > 800ms, or semantic-failure spike (intent-F1 drop > 6%). runbook: immediate pin, traffic split revert, incident channel notify, hotfix tagging.
Ellie (Comms): need customer-facing blurb per entry: note quantization tradeoffs, recommended prompts to avoid degradation, migration steps, contact for migration-engagement. short template please.
license-bot: REMINDER: include license_manifest file. required fields: model_source, weights_hash, license_spdx, commercial_ok (yes/no), vendor_contact.
Dina: splits for eval: short completions (<60 tok), multi-turn chat (avg 600 tok), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) slice, L10N fuzzy prompts. include at least one open-source public benchmark and one curated customer synthetic replay.
Ibrahim: on the customer replay — legal needs proof. Marcus — can we sanitize + hash?
Marcus: yes — we will salt+hash, store lineage in CAT-4910, and mark replay as "sanitized" in the manifest. add note if any redaction occurred.
Ellie (Comms): comms template: "Model: X.quantized — expected perf: ~X% cost savings, parity on common queries, possible regressions on long-context hallucination. Migration: opt-in pin for 30d; contact migrations@redwood.ai for hands-on support." happy to draft full copy.
Pat (SRE): canary schedule: 0.5% 30m -> 2% 3h -> 10% 12h -> 50% 48h. monitoring hooks: latency p95, error-rate, intent-f1, embedding-cosine-drift. owners: Marcus + Dina.
Dina: bench command (local runner):
```
./tools/run_bench.sh --model X.quant --slices short,multi-turn,rag --replay samples/sanitize-manifest.json --out results/X.quant.bench.json
```
Ibrahim: artifact list for PR: bench_results.json, bench_summary.md, license_manifest.yml, replay_manifest.json (if any), comms_snippet.md, runbook.md. all linked in the onboard PR.
license-bot: license check: if license_spdx not in ACCEPTED_LICENSES, escalate to legal-team.
Marcus: I'll add a deterministic smoke: exact-match on regression set + a quick semantic scorer (bert-sim) to tag any >5% drop. Keep the semantic check fast.
Pat (SRE): also include a traffic-backstop: ability to pin per-tenant for 14 days via console. ops-automation ticket TKT-7721 to enable auto-pin.
Ellie (Comms): i'll prepare customer migration FAQ and a short migration-notice template. will ping product_comms when ready.
Ibrahim: owners: Dina (bench + summary), Marcus (smoke + replay prep), Pat (runbook + canary), Ellie (comms), license-bot -> legal check. target: PR open Thu morning, signoffs by Fri EOD.
Dina: ack — i'll start running slices and will post initial numbers in the PR.
Marcus: starting sanitizer, will reference CAT-4910 lineage ticket in the replay manifest.
Pat (SRE): will draft runbook and attach monitoring dashboards.
license-bot: license fields required before merge.
Ellie (Comms): drafting comms now.
Ibrahim: great — let's meet Mon morning if any blockers. otherwise proceed to PR. :thumbsup:
